correctness.rationale: Orthogonal third-vector decomposition gives the fourth mixed projected residual as -(1-am)/(tau*r) times the fourth split projected residual. Third mixed step is nonzero because a!=0. Four distinct active eigenvalues are exactly the fourth split nonbreakdown criterion by a cubic polynomial argument; all indefinite symmetric matrices with four distinct eigenvalues admit a strictly positive four-weight solution am=1 using strict positive/negative spectral mixing and the intermediate value theorem. A condition-three 4x4 exact-rational witness has tau^2=103/539, third residual^2=564/847, and fourth split residual^2=14112/498623, with fourth mixed residual zero, independently reproduced by check.py.

value.rationale: The obstruction occurs only after three successful inverse-leading vectors, separates intrinsically growing extended spaces from algorithmic candidate breakdown, and applies to every indefinite spectrum with at least four values. A condition-three witness shows it is not simply a high-condition-number artifact; switching to a split channel can avoid the local obstruction. This later-step mechanism is not subsumed by an earlier third-step cancellation example.
